reviewType: Independent read-only final static preservation review

resolvedFindings.issue: A completed current action with missing prediction and reflection flags was labeled Plan needed although the native gate prioritizes the pending explanation.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final row state derives from currentLearningGate.required and currentLearningGate.phase; pending reflection is labeled Explanation needed. A noncurrent completed but unverified row is labeled Recorded action; evidence incomplete.
resolvedFindings.evidence: Applied renderTechniqueRoadmap current row derives state from currentLearningGate; procedureLearningGateFor remains unchanged.

editNames: Place progress inside the existing visible checkpoint
Expose the labelled native learning cycle as a group
Expose the labelled Guided evidence cycle as a group

checks.name: Native learning gates and scoring
checks.evidence: Gate, learning entry, summary, action completion, scoring, and handlers are unchanged by exact reversal. Display count calls procedureLearningSummary(currentProcedure); row verification uses its same action-complete plus predictionCorrect plus reflectionCorrect predicate.

checks.name: Current pending explanation and stale flags
checks.evidence: Required gate action takes precedence over procedureNext.action; row state follows native gate phase. Correct flags alone cannot verify an undone or incomplete physical action. Noncurrent completed actions with incomplete evidence are labeled recorded.

checks.name: Legacy learning records
checks.evidence: Existing procedureLearningEntry compatibility treats completed actions with no learningChecks record as legacy verified. Both count and rows retain that native interpretation, with no new learning credit logic.

checks.name: Native protocol labels and order
checks.evidence: Roadmap iterates procedureProtocol.order and takes procedureProtocol.actions[index], with native procedureActionLabel fallback. Original profiles remain byte-identical, including pin before cutting for earthworm and sheep eye.

checks.name: Undo and visibility
checks.evidence: Unchanged undoProcedureAction clears physical completion and reflection correctness; display recomputes from the restored state. New render call stays inside the unchanged procedureLearningCheckpointVisible guard. No exposure, view, or learning visibility logic changed.

checks.name: Information-only disclosure
checks.evidence: Native details and summary disclose an ordered list. New markup has no action handler or state update call; opening it grants no credit and performs no technique action.

checks.name: No new application state, timers, or saved fields
checks.evidence: Inserted function is derived rendering only and uses local values. No new hooks, upd or update calls, timers, event listeners, or saved fields are present.

checks.name: Single planning prompt
checks.evidence: New content uses protocol action labels and a short verification explanation; it does not repeat predictionPrompt or reflectionPrompt. Existing next-action suppression and phase-only stage headline stay byte-identical.

checks.name: Honest final review wording
checks.evidence: Only the final title changes from Specimen investigation complete to Review your specimen investigation. The final description, label, start-assessment action, branches, and assessment handlers remain byte-identical.

checks.name: Explicit native progress presentation
checks.evidence: The native progress element, value, max, and accessible label remain unchanged. New scoped CSS provides track and fill styles for WebKit and Firefox, matches the real data-high-contrast="true" root attribute, and uses Canvas and Highlight system colors under forced colors. App high contrast uses a white fill on a black track.

checks.name: Native phase group semantics
checks.evidence: Technique learning cycle and Guided evidence cycle divs each gain only role="group". Their existing translated aria-labels, phase children, functions, and handlers remain unchanged.

limits: Static review of staged source and exact changes. Browser layout and user interaction verification are handled by the separate browser auditor.
